proposal.name: 輸送車両を守れ

legend.V: convoy start B5; occupies one cell
legend.G: convoy destination J5; traversable if unoccupied
legend.u: reserved R6 reinforcement pad J2, traversable before spawn

board.routeTerrain: traversable for convoy; no obstacles, jumps or teleportations
tacticalIntent: The convoy advances east along row5. Three allies begin staggered and can move to escort or split to neutralize flank threats.
Enemy raider and gunner approach or fire from north of route; guard starts south of later route segments, threatening convoy flanks.
The late reinforcement near the destination challenges slow escorts without guaranteeing damage or forcing the player into a scripted loss.
board.lineOfSight: Walls block ordinary LOS as proposed in earlier Easy missions; convoy obstructs occupied tile. Global collision/LOS semantics take precedence when fixed.

roundEndProcessingOrder: Finish all legal unit turns and pending damage/events for the current round.
If convoy.hp<=0 or all allied robots are destroyed, apply defeat; no convoy movement.
Evaluate escort, adjacent enemies, and next route-cell occupancy against current end-of-round state.
Move convoy at most one route index forward if all movement checks pass; otherwise retain its cell and record stopReason.
If convoy reaches J5 alive, evaluate win and one-time 75%-HP subobjective.
If round12 completed without reaching J5, apply timeout defeat.

convoy.name: 護衛輸送車両

escortCheck.distanceMetric: Manhattan / orthogonal grid distance (candidate pending global distance convention)

blockadeCheck.blockingEnemies: any living enemy at orthogonal-adjacent current vehicle cell
blockadeCheck.blockingNextCell: any actor on next route cell including friendly robot or enemy

movement.clearToMove: at least one living ally within2 AND no living enemy orthogonally adjacent AND next route cell unoccupied/traversable

convoy.collisionResolution: Movement attempted only into empty next route cell; if occupied, vehicle waits and does not push/swap or share a tile.

main.win: convoy alive and at route index 8 after round-end automatic movement

subobjective.name: 車両HPを75%以上残して護衛

objectives.alliedEndurance: All 3 player robots are valid by default; no automatic resurrection.

reinforcements.occupiedSpawnPolicy: first traversable unoccupied fallback; if none free defer to next round; do not stack units
reinforcements.ifAllFallbacksBlockedAtRound12: do not spawn after mission end
reinforcements.stats: same M01 raider stats/weapon, no hidden difficulty scaling

enemySetup.equipmentModel: enemy profiles match proposed Easy M01 baseline; not using player inventories

enemyAI.baseline: reuse M01 attack-and-move AI, with objective-aware priorities
targetRules: Convoy is a legal enemy target under ordinary weapon range and LOS; no omniscient damage or extra attack.
When a direct legal attack on convoy can deal positive damage, favor it over nonlethal allied-unit damage unless the allied attack is a tactical elimination.
When no convoy shot is legal, pursue a tile enabling vehicle attack or block its future route; allies who block a path may be attacked.
A unit may move onto an unoccupied route cell to delay convoy but is not forced to waste a better legal attack.
Evaluate real legal moves, then deterministic tie-break by target ID and cell coordinates; no weakening when the player is near defeat.

roles.raider-0: close approach from north, threaten vehicle around E5/F5
roles.gunner-0: position for ranged fire along G5-J5; do not fire through cover
roles.guard-0: occupy or pressure southern segment of route around H5/I5; high DEF makes disengagement meaningful
roles.raider-wave-6: intercept late escort at I5/J5 with legal melee path

risks: One ally can keep the vehicle moving but may become exposed to combined enemy attacks.
Killing or dislodging enemies adjacent to the vehicle is sometimes more important than maximizing total dealt damage.
Leaving a player unit on the next route cell stalls the convoy; UI should show route and next-cell blockade.
Late reinforcements punish convoy delays; four or more blocked rounds lead to defeat even if convoy survives.
No victory guarantee: convoy can be killed, all allies can die, or vehicle can time out.

recommendedSeparation: Pure TypeScript auto-step function resolving end-of-round convoy state
enemyAI action selector using legal moves and mission priorities
separate one-time reward and subobjective predicates
implementationNotes.roundEndInvariant: vehicle routeIndex monotonically increases by 0 or 1 and vehicle cell equals route[routeIndex]

unresolved: Candidate 12-round deadline, vehicle HP130/DEF50 and start/destination B5/J5 await confirmation.
Manhattan distance 2 is a mission candidate until a common adjacency/range convention is selected.
Enemy adjacency and next-cell occupancy vehicle-blocking rule are candidate details, not a finalized global escort mechanic.
The enemy reinforcement at R6 and path/positions require simulation and balance review.
A player unit standing on the next route square is a deliberate temporary blockade; UI affordance is needed.
Global turn order, exact LOS, stacking collision, enemy movement legality and combat state effects are not implemented.
